title: Researched cold emails, handled replies and a weekly report for AVD

facts: Post: Albert Venture Design (AVD) wants a cold email outreach specialist for lead generation and sales outreach.
Post: research target prospects, build and run B2B cold email campaigns, personalized messaging, follow-ups for qualified leads.
Post: keep deliverability healthy, track performance, regular reporting on open rates, replies and booked meetings.
Post: experience with outreach platforms, prospect research and improving results through testing.

prospect.fact: a second warehouse opening in Columbus
